run_adsorb_atoms: run the adsorb_atoms function to relax an adslab system and compute adsorption energy
compute_adsorption_energy: compute adsorption energy from a relaxed adslab using the adsorb_atoms function with a calculator
relax_adslab_with_calculator: relax an adsorbate plus slab atoms object using adsorb_atoms with an ASE calculator and optimizer
compute_hybrid_adsorption_energy: compute hybrid adsorption energy combining ML relaxed adslab and DFT slab energies via adsorb_atoms
save_relaxed_adslab_atoms: run adsorb_atoms with save_relaxed_atoms enabled to return encoded relaxed adslab atom configurations
